]

# ملعبك الحر — مصنّف تعليقات المراجعة
# Your playground — the review-comment classifier

COMMENTS = [
    'nit: add a space after the comma',
    'blocking: this drops the last item',
    'does this handle the empty list?',
    'why is this 79 and not 88?',
    'nit: rename x to total',
    'looks good to me',
]

def classify(comment):
    if comment.startswith('nit:'):
        return 'nit'
    if comment.startswith('blocking:'):
        return 'blocking'
    if comment.endswith('?'):
        return 'question'
    return 'note'

for c in COMMENTS:
    print('%s -> %s' % (classify(c), c))

# ملعبك الحر — كاشفاتك المصغرة على شجرة ast
# Your playground — your mini detectors over the ast tree

import ast

SAMPLE = '''def report(items):
    # FIXME: this loop re-scans the list on every call, find a cheaper way
    total = 0
    for it in items:
        total = total + it
    return total
'''

tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE)
funcs = 0
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
        funcs = funcs + 1
print('functions: %d' % funcs)
print('docstring: %s' % ast.get_docstring(tree.body[0]))

for line in SAMPLE.split('\n'):
    if 'TODO' in line or 'FIXME' in line:
        print('flagged: %s' % line.strip())
